entities.name: Hindu Vedic Wedding (Vivaha)
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: The Hindu Vivaha (wedding) revolves around the sacred fire (Agni). The couple walks seven steps (Saptapadi) around the fire, each step a vow. The ceremony is described in the Rigveda — making it one of the oldest continuously practiced wedding rituals. The fire god Agni serves as divine witness.
